SELECT tc.id, tc.course_id, tc.course, tc.teacher_no, ct.weekday, ct.start_section, ct.end_section,
CONVERT(VARCHAR, ISNULL(cct.course_type, tc.course_type)) IFNULL(cct.course_type, tc.course_type) as course_type, ct.location FROM student_course_selection scs JOIN teacher_course tc ON scs.course_id = tc.course_id JOIN class_time ct ON scs.course_id = ct.course_id JOIN student_info s ON scs.student_no = s.student_no LEFT JOIN class_course_type cct ON tc.course_id = cct.course_id AND cct.class_id = s.class_name AND cct.year = s.year WHERE scs.student_no = #{studentNo}
